name: print-social-public-transportation-posts-blue-and-yellow-with-arch-photos
title: Public transportation pack in blue and yellow with arch-framed commuter photos and line icons
whatItIs: Five white posts with royal-blue diagonal bands and yellow-outlined arch and circle photo frames of masked commuters on buses and trains, bold blue headlines ('Public Transportation', 'Avoid Traffic Jams'), blue circle badges ('Book now', '$20 per week'), yellow URL pills and thin line icons of trains, pins and planes.
whatItMeans: Clear and civic; blue and yellow feel like transit signage.
techniques: Frame photos in arches with a yellow outline.
Use diagonal blue bands for motion.
Put prices and CTAs in circle badges.

vocabulary.definition: Colours borrowed from signage for clarity.
A round label for offers or CTAs.
